name: Calendly
description: Calendly is a scheduling tool that connects to a user's calendar and lets them share a booking link so others can pick an open time slot without back-and-forth emails.
best_for: Positioned for solopreneurs up through large enterprises, with named use cases in sales, marketing, customer success, recruiting, and education.
features: Connects and syncs up to six calendars for real-time availability
Customizable availability rules and buffer times
Integrates with Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, and Webex
Multiple event types: one-on-one, collective, and round robin
AI meeting notetaker for recaps and action items

alternatives.name: Doodle
alternatives.description: A scheduling and coordination tool that finds a meeting time across a group's calendars via polls and booking pages.
alternatives.best_for: Coordinating a time across a group rather than one-on-one booking

alternatives.name: Cal.com
alternatives.description: An open, customizable scheduling platform where users share a booking link that syncs calendars and handles meeting logistics.
alternatives.best_for: Developers and teams wanting an open, customizable scheduling tool

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: Always free; one event type, one calendar connection, one-on-one scheduling, and customizable booking page.

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.notes: $10/seat/month billed yearly; unlimited event types, multiple calendars, automations/reminders, Stripe/PayPal, HubSpot and Mailchimp connections.

tiers.name: Teams
tiers.notes: $16/seat/month billed yearly; adds round-robin and team scheduling, routing, centrally managed event types, and Salesforce handoff.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Starts at $15,000/year and 50 seats; contact sales.
